title: ContentCaptureRequested
description:
Payload of `content.capture.requested.v1`: capture one document and extract it.

Exactly one source is named:

- `url`: an `http` or `https` address the extractor fetches.
- `blob`: bytes another service already stored, named by a content-addressed [`BlobRef`]. The
  extractor reads them from the owning service's blob root, so the digest algorithm is
  `sha256` (the only algorithm [`ContentDigest`] has) and the owner decides what it is willing
  to hand over.

A payload with both or neither is refused when it is decoded. The generated JSON Schema lists
both members as optional: it cannot say "exactly one" without a root `oneOf`, which the
TypeScript projection refuses as unrepresentable, so the Rust type alone enforces the rule
(the ADR-0001 lower-bound rule) and the invalid fixtures name the serde layer.

The enclosing command envelope carries the owner (`tenant_id`), correlation and delivery
identity; its `aggregate_id` is `operation:<operation_id>`, and the extractor refuses an
envelope whose aggregate disagrees with `operation_id`.

blob.description: The stored bytes to extract. Absent exactly when `url` is present.

idempotency_key.description:
SHA-256 of the caller's idempotency string, so a redelivery or a repeated request
collapses into one capture. For a capture issued from a social bookmark the string is the
capture identity.

operation_id.description: Platform operation this capture belongs to.

url.description: The address to fetch. Absent exactly when `blob` is present.

BlobOwner.title: BlobOwner
BlobOwner.description: Deployment identity of the service that owns and resolves a blob.

BlobRef.description:
Reference to content-addressed bytes owned by one service.

This is a reference, not a storage API. The owner writes and resolves the bytes under its own
content-addressed directory. No host, filesystem path, signed URL, credentials, or expiry can
appear in this contract.

digest.description: Digest that names the bytes and lets a reader verify them.

length_bytes.description: Exact byte length of the stored value.

media_type.description: Media type of the stored bytes.

owner_service.description: Service that owns the bytes and their lifecycle.

CaptureUrl.title: CaptureUrl
CaptureUrl.description:
An absolute `http` or `https` URL to capture, at most 2048 characters and without
spaces or control characters.

This type fixes the carrier only. Whether the URL is publicly fetchable is decided by the
extractor's own address policy, which refuses a private or non-routable target.

ContentDigest.description: A content digest with an explicit algorithm.

DigestAlgorithm.description: Algorithm used to calculate a content digest.

DigestHex.title: DigestHex
DigestHex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal bytes of a content digest.

MediaType.title: MediaType
MediaType.description: Internet media type of stored bytes, without parameters.

OperationId.title: OperationId
OperationId.description: Identity of one long-running operation, stable for its whole lifecycle. Bare canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID; not namespaced.
